title: This Is the Life
goal: Learn the words first, notice the past continuous and going to, and think about what a night out really feels like.
goal_it: Impara prima le parole, nota il past continuous e going to, e pensa a cosa si prova davvero in una serata fuori.

steps.title: About the song
en: Title: This Is the Life. Artist: Amy Macdonald, a Scottish singer-songwriter. The song comes from her first album, also called This Is the Life (2007), and it was a big hit in many European countries. It is a lively song about a night out in a city.
Search for the title and the artist in your own music app. Listen three times this week, each time with a different job:
Listening 1: catch the words from the next screen. Listening 2: notice the grammar points. Listening 3: think about how the night feels, and what the song really says about it.
it: Titolo: This Is the Life. Artista: Amy Macdonald, cantautrice scozzese. La canzone viene dal suo primo album, che si chiama anch'esso This Is the Life (2007), ed è stata un grande successo in molti paesi europei. È una canzone vivace su una serata fuori in città.
Cerca titolo e artista nella tua app di musica. Ascoltala tre volte questa settimana, ogni volta con un compito diverso:
Ascolto 1: individua le parole della prossima schermata. Ascolto 2: nota i punti di grammatica. Ascolto 3: pensa a come si sente la serata e a cosa dice davvero la canzone.

steps.title: Words you will hear
en: These words are in the song or very close to its world. Learn them first, then try to catch them while you listen.
it: Queste parole sono nella canzone o molto vicine al suo mondo. Imparale prima, poi prova a riconoscerle mentre ascolti.

head: English
Italiano
Example
rows: The wind is very cold tonight.
The wind whistles through the old window.
The children chased the dog down the street.
She is shy, so she sat alone at the party.
We took a taxi home at midnight.
A big crowd was waiting outside the club.
The music got louder and louder.
I woke up very late this morning.

steps.q: The children chased the dog down the street. What does 'chased' mean?
steps.q_it: The children chased the dog down the street. Che cosa significa 'chased'?
options: They fed it
They washed it
They ran after it
They called a taxi for it
steps.why: To chase means to run after someone or something to catch it.
steps.why_it: To chase significa correre dietro a qualcuno o qualcosa per prenderlo.

steps.q: In winter the cold wind always ___ (whistle) through this street.
steps.q_it: In inverno il vento freddo ___ (whistle) sempre in questa strada.
steps.why: Present simple, third person singular (the wind): whistles.
steps.why_it: Present simple, terza persona singolare (the wind): whistles.

steps.q: After the party I ___ (wake) up at noon.
steps.q_it: Dopo la festa mi ___ (wake) a mezzogiorno.
steps.why: The past simple of wake is woke. It is an irregular verb.
steps.why_it: Il past simple di wake è woke. È un verbo irregolare.

steps.title: Three grammar points to watch for
steps.title_it: Tre punti di grammatica da tenere d'occhio
en: 1. Past continuous (was / were + -ing): what was in progress at a moment in the past. At midnight everybody was dancing. The song paints a scene like this.
2. Going to and 'gonna'. In songs and fast speech, going to becomes gonna: Where you gonna sleep? means Where are you going to sleep? Say gonna if you like, but write going to.
3. Present continuous for what is happening now, and present simple for the general picture: You are waiting at the door. The wind whistles. Listen to how the song moves between the two.
During listening 2, try to notice where the singer uses each one.
it: 1. Past continuous (was / were + -ing): ciò che era in corso in un momento del passato. At midnight everybody was dancing. La canzone dipinge una scena così.
2. Going to e 'gonna'. Nelle canzoni e nel parlato veloce, going to diventa gonna: Where you gonna sleep? vuol dire Where are you going to sleep? Puoi dire gonna, ma scrivi going to.
3. Present continuous per ciò che succede adesso, e present simple per il quadro generale: You are waiting at the door. The wind whistles. Ascolta come la canzone passa dall'uno all'altro.
Nell'ascolto 2 prova a notare dove il cantante usa ciascuno.

examples.en: The band was playing when the lights went out.
examples.it: La band stava suonando quando le luci si sono spente.

examples.en: Where are you going to sleep tonight?
You are waiting outside the door.

steps.q: The band ___ when the lights went out. Choose the best option.
steps.q_it: The band ___ when the lights went out. Scegli l'opzione migliore.
options: played
was playing
has played
plays
steps.why: The music was in progress when the lights went out: past continuous (was playing) for the long action, past simple (went out) for the short one.
steps.why_it: La musica era in corso quando le luci si sono spente: past continuous (was playing) per l'azione lunga, past simple (went out) per quella breve.

steps.q: Where ___ you going to sleep tonight?
steps.q_it: Dove ___ you going to sleep stanotte?
steps.why: Going to: am / is / are + going to + verb. With you: are.
steps.why_it: Going to: am / is / are + going to + verbo. Con you: are.

steps.q: In fast speech, 'Where you gonna go?' means:
steps.q_it: Nel parlato veloce, 'Where you gonna go?' vuol dire:
options: Where do you go every day?
Where did you go yesterday?
Where are you going to go?
Where have you been?
steps.why: Gonna is the spoken form of going to: Where are you going to go?
steps.why_it: Gonna è la forma parlata di going to: Where are you going to go?

answers: What were they doing at midnight
steps.why: Question word + were + subject + -ing. Past continuous.
steps.why_it: Parola interrogativa + were + soggetto + -ing. Past continuous.

steps.title: Now listen (listening 1 and 2)
en: Listen to the song twice. First catch the words from the screen about words. Then notice the grammar points. After listening, answer the questions about meaning.
it: Ascolta la canzone due volte. Prima individua le parole della schermata sulle parole. Poi nota i punti di grammatica. Dopo l'ascolto, rispondi alle domande sul significato.

steps.q: The song puts a crowd that feels 'this is the life' next to the question of where to sleep. What is the effect?
steps.q_it: La canzone mette una folla che sente 'this is the life' accanto alla domanda su dove dormire. Che effetto fa?
options: It shows that the singer hates parties
It shows that the fun and the uncertainty exist together
It shows that she is lost in a foreign country
It shows that she wants to go home early
steps.why: The good feeling of the night and the lack of a plan sit side by side. That is why the mood is bittersweet.
steps.why_it: Il bel momento della serata e l'assenza di un piano stanno fianco a fianco. Per questo il tono è dolceamaro.

steps.q: Some people sit apart from the dancing crowd. Why does the song notice them?
steps.q_it: Alcune persone stanno in disparte rispetto alla folla che balla. Perché la canzone le nota?
options: Because it is a song only about shy people
Because they are the singer's family
Because they are about to leave
Because it shows that not everyone feels part of the party
steps.why: Seen from outside, a party looks different. The song looks at the edges as well as the centre.
steps.why_it: Visto da fuori, una festa sembra diversa. La canzone guarda ai bordi oltre che al centro.

steps.q: Nobody is at home when the person arrives at the friend's door. What does this small moment add?
steps.q_it: Non c'è nessuno quando la persona arriva alla porta dell'amico. Che cosa aggiunge questo piccolo momento?
options: A happy surprise
A sign that the plans of a night can fall apart
An explanation for why the music is loud
A joke about taxis
steps.why: A closed door means waiting with no plan. It adds the feeling of being a little lost.
steps.why_it: Una porta chiusa significa aspettare senza un piano. Aggiunge la sensazione di essere un po' persi.

steps.q: Which reading of the title 'This Is the Life' is best?
steps.q_it: Quale lettura del titolo 'This Is the Life' è la migliore?
options: It is completely serious, with no doubts
It is a complaint about work
It is a sad goodbye
It is real pleasure in the moment, said with a light, slightly ironic smile
steps.why: The song enjoys the night, but it also shows the tiredness and uncertainty. So the title is both sincere and a little ironic.
steps.why_it: La canzone si gode la serata, ma mostra anche stanchezza e incertezza. Quindi il titolo è sincero e insieme un po' ironico.

steps.q: What do the dancing crowd, the taxi and the closed door have in common?
steps.q_it: Che cosa hanno in comune la folla che balla, il taxi e la porta chiusa?
options: They are all places the singer lived
They are all moments of one night, moving from noise to waiting
They all happen in the morning
They are all dangerous
steps.why: They are scenes from the same night. The mood goes from noise and energy to waiting.
steps.why_it: Sono scene della stessa serata. Il clima passa da rumore ed energia ad attesa.

steps.q: Which sentence is the best summary of the singer's attitude?
steps.q_it: Quale frase riassume meglio l'atteggiamento della cantante?
options: She is angry with her friends
She regrets going out
She wants only to be famous
She enjoys the energy of the night, but also sees its restlessness
steps.why: The song celebrates the night and, at the same time, notices the restlessness and the loneliness inside it.
steps.why_it: La canzone celebra la serata e allo stesso tempo nota l'inquietudine e la solitudine che ci sono dentro.

steps.q: Last Saturday I ___ (take) a taxi home after the concert.
steps.q_it: Sabato scorso ___ (take) un taxi per tornare a casa dopo il concerto.
steps.why: The past simple of take is took. Last Saturday is a finished time.
steps.why_it: Il past simple di take è took. Last Saturday è un tempo finito.

steps.why: Present continuous question: Are + you + -ing. It can also talk about plans.
steps.why_it: Domanda al present continuous: Are + you + -ing. Può anche parlare di programmi.

steps.title: Your task this week
en: Listening 3: listen again and think about how the night feels and what the song really says about it.

In your notes write four sentences in your own words: (1) What you were doing at ten o'clock yesterday evening (past continuous). (2) A plan for next weekend (going to). (3) One place you like for a night out and one you do not. (4) What 'the good life' means to you.
Do not copy the words of the song.
it: Ascolto 3: riascolta e pensa a come si sente la serata e a cosa dice davvero la canzone.

Nelle note scrivi quattro frasi con parole tue: (1) Cosa stavi facendo ieri sera alle dieci (past continuous). (2) Un programma per il prossimo weekend (going to). (3) Un posto che ti piace per una serata fuori e uno che non ti piace. (4) Cosa significa per te 'la bella vita'.
Non copiare le parole della canzone.

cards.ex: The wind is very cold tonight.
The wind whistles through the old window.
She is shy, so she sat alone.
A big crowd was waiting outside.
I woke up very late this morning.
The band was playing when the lights went out.
Where are you going to sleep tonight?
